description: Needs at least one of query, city or type. Search the public Soundcheck places directory for venues and hotels (directory.soundchecklive.io): name search, city-only queries such as "venues in Nashville", or filters by city and type. Returns directory UUIDs, structured address, capacity or star rating when known, and the public directory URL. Legacy seed ids from the bundled pricing catalog still resolve through get_place.

city.description: city to filter by, e.g. "Austin" or "Nashville"

query.description: name or free-text search, e.g. "Moody Theater" or "venues in Nashville" (max 200 characters)

type.description: limit results to venues or hotels

name: search_places

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Search venues and hotels
